meta.title: Game Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert mouse sensitivity between any of 13+ games — CS2, Valorant, Apex, Overwatch 2, PUBG, Fortnite, Call of Duty, Battlefield 2042, Halo, Warframe and more. Precise cm/360° math, bidirectional, any game pair.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
desc: Convert mouse sensitivity between any of 13+ games — CS2, Valorant, Apex, Overwatch 2, PUBG, Fortnite, Call of Duty, Battlefield 2042, Halo, Warframe and more. Precise cm/360° math, bidirectional, any game pair.
sensInvalid: Please enter a valid sensitivity (greater than 0)
dpiInvalid: Please enter a valid DPI (greater than 0)
ui.102: Mouse distance for one full rotation
steps_generic_1Desc: Pick the source game on the left, enter your sensitivity value, and confirm the mouse DPI is correct.
steps_generic_2Desc: The equivalent is computed automatically from the same cm/360° rotation distance and shown instantly, with a full list of conversions for every game.
steps_generic_3: Copy and apply in the target game
steps_generic_3Desc: Copy the result and apply it in the target game's settings. Matched sensitivity does not mean identical feel — warm up in a practice mode first.
steps_apex-to-cs2-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Apex sensitivity and current FOV. These values are used to calculate the CS2 equivalent sensitivity.
steps_apex-to-cs2-sensitivity_2Desc: The CS2 sensitivity displays instantly, accounting for FOV scaling differences. CS2's narrower default FOV makes sensitivity feel different.
steps_apex-to-cs2-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in CS2. Play deathmatch for at least 15 minutes — CS2's emphasis on crosshair placement and pre-aiming differs from Apex's tracking focus.
steps_apex-to-valorant-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Apex sensitivity and FOV. Apex's higher FOV default (110) vs Valorant (103) affects perceived sensitivity.
steps_apex-to-valorant-sensitivity_2Desc: The converted Valorant sensitivity accounts for FOV differences between the two games for a more accurate feel translation.
steps_apex-to-valorant-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in Valorant. Expect an adjustment period — Apex's fast movement contrasts with Valorant's tactical, hold-angle playstyle.
steps_cod-to-cs2-sensitivity_1: Enter your Call of Duty sensitivity
steps_cod-to-cs2-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your CoD mouse sensitivity. CoD's faster time-to-kill and respawn mechanics differ significantly from CS2's tactical gameplay.
steps_cod-to-cs2-sensitivity_2Desc: The CS2 sensitivity displays instantly, adjusted for the different FOV defaults and game engine characteristics between CoD and CS2.
steps_cod-to-cs2-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in CS2. Expect the sensitivity to feel slower — CS2 rewards precision and crosshair placement more than CoD's run-and-gun style.
steps_cs2-to-apex-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your CS2 mouse sensitivity. The converter accounts for the different FOV defaults between CS2 and Apex Legends.
steps_cs2-to-apex-sensitivity_2Desc: Your Apex equivalent sensitivity is calculated. The result is adjusted for Apex's wider default FOV and different movement speed.
steps_cs2-to-apex-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in Apex Legends. Spend time in the Firing Range practicing tracking on moving targets before dropping into battle royale.
steps_cs2-to-cod-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your CS2 mouse sensitivity. The converter scales it up for Call of Duty's faster movement and more aggressive play style.
steps_cs2-to-cod-sensitivity_2Desc: Your CoD equivalent sensitivity appears. The calculation accounts for the different default FOV and game engine between the two titles.
steps_cs2-to-cod-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in Call of Duty. Play a few casual matches — CoD's faster pace may make the converted sensitivity feel lower than expected initially.
steps_cs2-to-overwatch2-sensitivity_1Des: Input your CS2 mouse sensitivity. The converter transforms this for Overwatch 2's different FOV, movement speed, and aiming style.
steps_cs2-to-overwatch2-sensitivity_2Des: Your OW2 sensitivity appears instantly. The calculation accounts for FOV and engine differences between the two games.
steps_cs2-to-overwatch2-sensitivity_3Des: Apply in Overwatch 2. Quick Play is the best environment to adjust — the hero variety and game pace differ significantly from CS2.
steps_cs2-to-pubg-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your CS2 mouse sensitivity. PUBG has multiple sensitivity settings — this converts your base hipfire sensitivity.
steps_cs2-to-pubg-sensitivity_2Desc: The PUBG general sensitivity displays. For scope sensitivities, multiply by PUBG's scope sensitivity multipliers for each magnification level.
steps_cs2-to-pubg-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in PUBG. Test in Training Mode — PUBG's realistic recoil patterns and bullet drop mean aim feel differs from CS2.
steps_cs2-to-valorant-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your CS2 sensitivity value. The standard conversion formula is CS2 sensitivity ÷ 3.18 = Valorant sensitivity.
steps_cs2-to-valorant-sensitivity_2Desc: Your Valorant equivalent sensitivity displays instantly. Both hipfire and zoom sensitivity are calculated for a complete conversion.
steps_cs2-to-valorant-sensitivity_3Desc: Copy the result and paste it into Valorant Settings → General → Mouse → Sensitivity: Aim. Fine-tune ±10% to match your personal feel.
steps_fortnite-to-valorant-sensitivity_1: Input your Fortnite mouse sensitivity. Include targeting and scope sensitivities for the most complete conversion possible.
steps_fortnite-to-valorant-sensitivity_2: The Valorant sensitivity displays instantly. Fortnite's third-person view and building mechanics create a very different aiming context.
steps_fortnite-to-valorant-sensitivity_3: Apply in Valorant. Expect a significant adjustment period — the switch from third-person building to first-person tactical shooting is substantial.
steps_overwatch2-to-cs2-sensitivity_1Des: Input your OW2 sensitivity and FOV. The converter scales it appropriately for CS2's slower, more tactical gameplay.
steps_overwatch2-to-cs2-sensitivity_2Des: The CS2 sensitivity appears instantly. FOV scaling is applied so your mouse movement distance for a 360° turn is preserved.
steps_overwatch2-to-cs2-sensitivity_3Des: Apply in CS2. Expect the sensitivity to feel lower — CS2 emphasizes crosshair placement and angle holding rather than tracking.
steps_overwatch2-to-valorant-sensitivity: Input your OW2 sensitivity and FOV. OW2's faster movement and diverse hero abilities create a different aiming context than Valorant.
The Valorant sensitivity is calculated with FOV compensation. Expect it to feel slower due to Valorant's more tactical, angle-holding gameplay.
Apply in Valorant. The adjustment period may take several days — Valorant rewards precise crosshair placement more than OW2's tracking-heavy aim.
steps_pubg-to-cs2-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your PUBG general sensitivity. If you use different scope sensitivities, convert each one individually for best results.
steps_pubg-to-cs2-sensitivity_2Desc: The CS2 sensitivity appears instantly. PUBG's realistic weapon mechanics and slower pace mean the aiming feel differs from CS2.
steps_pubg-to-cs2-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in CS2. Practice in deathmatch and workshop aim training maps to build muscle memory with the converted sensitivity.
steps_valorant-to-apex-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Valorant sensitivity. The converter adjusts for Apex Legends' higher default FOV and different game engine.
steps_valorant-to-apex-sensitivity_2Desc: The Apex sensitivity value adjusts for FOV scaling and engine differences. Both hipfire and ADS sensitivities are calculated.
steps_valorant-to-apex-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in Apex Legends. Test in the Firing Range with different weapons — tracking aim is more important in Apex than in Valorant.
steps_valorant-to-cs2-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Valorant aim sensitivity. The formula is Valorant sensitivity × 3.18 = CS2 sensitivity.
steps_valorant-to-cs2-sensitivity_2Desc: The equivalent CS2 sensitivity appears instantly. Both are mathematically matched to produce the same cm/360° rotation distance.
steps_valorant-to-cs2-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in CS2 Settings → Keyboard/Mouse → Mouse Sensitivity. Play deathmatch to adjust — CS2's movement feel differs from Valorant despite matched sensitivity.
steps_valorant-to-fortnite-sensitivity_1: Input your Valorant sensitivity. The converter scales it for Fortnite's third-person perspective and faster-paced gameplay.
steps_valorant-to-fortnite-sensitivity_2: Your Fortnite equivalent sensitivity appears. This is your hipfire sensitivity — targeting and scope sensitivities may need separate tuning.
steps_valorant-to-fortnite-sensitivity_3: Apply in Fortnite. Test in Creative mode — Fortnite requires both accurate shooting and quick building, so sensitivity is a balance of both.
steps_valorant-to-overwatch2-sensitivity: Input your Valorant aim sensitivity. The converter scales it up for OW2's faster-paced, ability-heavy gameplay environment.
The OW2 equivalent displays instantly. The sensitivity is adjusted for OW2's wider FOV and faster character movement speeds.
Apply in Overwatch 2. Try different heroes in Quick Play — hitscan and projectile heroes may feel different even with the same sensitivity.
